description: This file defines the ApiProvider class in the Aws\Api namespace, which provides methods for resolving, loading, and managing API data for AWS services based on a manifest or filesystem. It includes resolving API providers, handling version selection, and exception handling for unresolved APIs.

classes.name: ApiProvider
classes.description: Provides methods for resolving, loading, and managing AWS API data, including default and custom provider configurations, version handling, and exception management.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves an API provider, ensuring a non-null array is returned or throws UnresolvedApiException if resolution fails.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns a default API provider that loads pre-built manifest data from the data directory.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Creates an API provider with a specified directory and manifest data.

methods.name: filesystem
methods.description: Creates an API provider based on a filesystem directory containing service models.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Returns an array of valid API versions for a given service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the provider, loading API data for a specific type, service, and version.
